title: US-Israeli bombing destroyed nearly 10,000 civilian sites, says Iranian UN envoy
summary: Tehran was targeted by heavy bombardments on March 11 as the US-Israeli military campaign continued. The day before, US Secretary Pete Hegseth had warned that Iran would know the 'most intense day' of US strikes. Nearly 10,000 civilian sites have been destroyed since the war started, according to Iran's U.N. envoy.
